name: Tāmaki Makaurau — tabletop terrain
verticalDatum: NZVD2016 (EPSG:7839), per LINZ national DEM documentation

waterMask.method: OSM polygon even-odd containment; mapped water omitted regardless of elevation; low land preserved

limits: Inverse-distance interpolation of up to four existing LINZ samples; omit cells >110m from data and triangles with water/nodata vertices. Coastline discretised to mesh grid. No buildings. Not navigation, hazard or survey data.
